# Vendored math renderer

- KaTeX: 0.18.1
- npm package: `katex@0.18.1`
- npm package SHA-1: `98c3e169ef9196072ec857e893beb88374519014`
- License: MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- Runtime files: `katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, `contrib/auto-render.min.js`, and `fonts/*.woff2`.
